barren_no_spray: No pre-emergence spray on bare soil this close to sowing unless needed for weeds/stubble.
barren_spray_rain_delay: Rain forecast — delay herbicide/stubble treatment until the field is dry.
barren_spray_consider: Consider weed/stubble management on barren field before sowing (not crop foliar spray).
barren_spray_hint: If heavy weeds or stubble: use recommended pre-sowing herbicide or remove mechanically. Avoid spray within 48 hours of expected rain.
barren_fert_plan: Basal fertilizer is applied at or just before sowing. Prepare quantities for planned {crop}.
barren_fert_active: Sowing window active — prepare and apply basal dose for {crop}.
barren_irr_ok: Soil moisture adequate for land prep. Avoid waterlogging before sowing.
barren_irr_dry_optional: Soil moisture low but not yet sowing week — light irrigation optional before final tillage.
barren_irr_pre_sowing_only: Pre-sowing irrigation only if seedbed is dry at sowing depth.
barren_irr_rain_hold: Rain expected this week — do not irrigate until drainage is confirmed.
barren_irr_dry_sow: Soil is dry ahead of sowing — light pre-sowing irrigation to bring moisture to seed depth.
barren_irr_light: One light irrigation 2–4 days before sowing (or soak if furrow sowing). Stop if rain is forecast.
barren_monitoring: Check weed pressure, soil moisture at 10–15 cm, and field levelness. Update expected sowing date after sowing.
barren_sowing_passed: Expected sowing date has passed. Reassess soil moisture and variety window before sowing.
barren_heavy_rain: Heavy rain expected in the next 3 days. Delay final land prep and sowing until topsoil drains.
barren_heat: Very high temperatures forecast. Prefer evening sowing or wait for a cooler spell.
barren_rain_sowing_week: Moderate rain near sowing week. Complete primary tillage now; sow after rain clears.
barren_dry_window: Relatively dry window ahead — good for land leveling, final tillage, and basal fertilizer incorporation.
barren_monitor_weekly: Monitor forecast weekly. Complete deep ploughing and residue management before the sowing week.
weather_days_note_overdue: Sowing date was {days} day(s) ago — update or sow soon.
crop_risk_action_high: Adjust sowing date or variety window; do not sow into waterlogged soil.
crop_risk_action_low: Follow land prep checklist and monitor forecast daily near sowing week.
carbon_note_organic: Before sowing: add compost/FYM to improve organic matter and long-term carbon capture.
carbon_note_conventional: Plan residue retention and efficient fertilizer use from the first crop cycle.
plant_growth_description: No standing crop. Preparing for {crop} ({variety}). Expected sowing: {date}.
crop_health_recommendation: Barren field — no crop in ground. Follow pre-sowing checklist for {crop}. {reason}
yield_explanation: Standard yield = crop profile benchmark (per hectare) x farm area. AI yield adjusts that using growth, health, greenness, water, and nutrients.
yield_explanation_short: Standard = crop profile benchmark × farm area. AI adjusts using growth, health, temperature, water, and soil fertility.
yield_skipped_maturity: Yield estimate is shown only at maturity/harvest stage.
yield_skipped_barren: Yield estimate is shown only after the crop is sown.
crop_weather_heavy_rain: Heavy rain expected in the next 3 days (~{rain3} mm) — delay spray and adjust irrigation.
crop_weather_light_rain: Light to moderate rain in the next 3 days (~{rain3} mm).
crop_weather_dry_week: Dry week ahead — plan irrigation per schedule.
crop_weather_clear: No major rain risk in the next few days.
crop_risk_action_high: Scout field within 24 hours; address irrigation and nutrition first.
crop_risk_action_moderate: Monitor stressed zones; confirm irrigation and leaf color.
crop_monitor_default: Check {checks}. Repeat every 3–4 days or after rain.
crop_carbon_unavailable: Carbon data not available for this cycle.
crop_carbon_positive: Net carbon positive for the farm — maintain residue and organic matter.
crop_carbon_negative: Higher emissions than capture — consider efficient irrigation and balanced fertilizer.
crop_carbon_message: Estimated emissions {emission} kg CO₂, capture {capture} kg CO₂. Net {net} kg CO₂. {note}
harvest_reduce_irr: Reduce irrigation before harvest unless soil is very dry.
decision_organic_no_spray: Organic farm — no chemical spray. Use neem oil or approved biopesticides.
decision_wind_rain_no_spray: Wind is high or rain is expected. Skip spray today.
decision_stable_no_spray: Crop health is stable. No spray needed today.
decision_stress_spray: Crop stress or sensitive stage. Consider preventive spray.
decision_spray_choose: Choose one product based on observed pest or disease and label guidance.
decision_npk_missing: NPK data is missing. Verify soil or fertilizer records before fertigation.
decision_no_fert_window: No fertigation window for the current growth stage.
decision_nutrients_balanced: Nutrients are balanced. No fertigation needed today.
decision_organic_fert: Organic farm: use only organic inputs.
decision_inorganic_fert: Inorganic farm: apply chemical fertilizer per nutrient deficit.
decision_integrated_fert: Integrated farm: combine organic and chemical inputs per schedule.
decision_irrigation_drip: Run drip or sprinkler for {minutes} minutes.
